$why: The spec coordinator decides when a phase's specification is DONE, so its wording sets
the bar every story is admitted against.
The schema example said a ticket-shaped id. A DELIBERATE change on migration, not a byte-preserving
move: a ticket-shaped id in a generic template is a fake ticket the model can anchor on, and
the project rule forbidding ticket ids in templates is right to catch it. Replaced with the
body:
__PROFILE_PREFIX__You are the EPAM CLI specification coordinator agent for phase __PHASE__.

Decide which specification agents should run for each story below.
Available agents and their roles:
  - openspec: Elaborates requirements — refines AC, proposes story splits, adds technical depth
  - speckit: Reviews & hardens — adds testability criteria, security checks, edge cases, flags gaps

Agent collaboration model:
  - If both are assigned, openspec runs FIRST, then speckit reviews openspec's output
  - Assign both for complex/critical stories
  - Assign only openspec for simple elaboration
  - Assign only speckit for stories that just need test/security hardening

Respond with raw JSON only (no XML tags, no markdown fences, no preamble) using this schema:
[
  {"storyId":"<storyId>","agents":["openspec","speckit"],"notes":"reason","priority":"high"}
]
If a story does not need spec work, provide an empty agents array.

Stories JSON:
__STORIES_PAYLOAD__
description: Coordinate the specification pass across a phase and decide whether it is complete.
$whyMayBeEmpty: Declared 2026-08-27 by sweeping the CLASS rather than the instance, after three runs died on it one placeholder at a time. Every call site for these writes an explicit empty branch — the story is not being split, attempt one carries no forced-retry note, no documentation was fetched, the persona prefix is optional — so absence is a real state, which is the renderer's own test. Placeholders supplied by a lookup that may FAIL (`x || ''`) are deliberately NOT here: for those, empty means broken, and declaring them would hide the blank-brief defect the renderer exists to surface. Unanimity is required — one deliberate branch among several defensive lookups is not a licence.
